#### SupportsGlobalDiscovery

```text
public static System.Boolean SupportsGlobalDiscovery(PPDS.Auth.Profiles.AuthMethod authMethod)
```

Checks if an authentication method supports Global Discovery.

- Parameter `authMethod`: The authentication method to check.

Returns: True if the method can be used with Global Discovery; otherwise false.

Remarks: Global Discovery requires delegated user authentication via MSAL public client. Only InteractiveBrowser and DeviceCode are supported.

Gets the HomeAccountId captured during interactive authentication.


Remarks: This value is only populated after PPDS.Auth.Discovery.GlobalDiscoveryService.DiscoverEnvironmentsAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken) completes and only if interactive authentication was required (not silent). Callers should persist this value to the profile to enable silent auth on subsequent calls.
